title: leplaea laurentii
intro: Leplaea laurentii, commonly known as African bush mango, is a tropical tree species native to the tropical regions of Central and West Africa. The health benefits of Leplaea laurentii include its potential use in treating various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its high antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant activities, which can help protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Leplaea laurentii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
